propositions: gerrit-verify.yaml and test.yml hand-copy identical gate+suite commands, creating drift risk; this duplication should be replaced by a single reusable workflow_call.

A new parameterized reusable workflow _build-and-test.yml should define lint, pip-audit, and test jobs with checkout logic keyed by gerrit-refspec (matching _optionality.yml pattern) and take no secrets.

Both test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml must delegate to the shared _build-and-test.yml; gerrit-verify's build-and-test job becomes a reusable-call that still satisfies vote needs, preserving the Verified vote end-to-end.

test_ci_workflow_parity.py's five safety functions must be rewritten to assert single-source delegation and reusable content rather than command string copying; three invariants (script gate asymmetry, pre-commit SKIPs, redundant hook SKIPs) are preserved and retargeted at the reusable.
test_workflow_names.py must be updated to cover _build-and-test.yml with the name 'Build and Test (reusable)'.
